concept: Premium Unicorn Entertainment Tracker. Replacing standard SaaS flat dark UI with a deep, cinematic obsidian look and high-tension 'Electric Coral' accents.

scales.h1_hero: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none

grids.horizontal_rail: flex overflow-x-auto gap-4 md:gap-6 pb-6 snap-x snap-mandatory scrollbar-hide
grids.calendar_grid: grid grid-cols-7 gap-px bg-white/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden border border-white/10

surfaces.header_nav: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#0A0A0C]/70 backdrop-blur-2xl backdrop-saturate-150 border-b border-white/5

poster_card.container: group relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white/5 border border-white/5 transition-all duration-500 hover:border-white/20 hover:-translate-y-2 hover:shadow-[0_20px_40px_-15px_rgba(255,42,84,0.15)] snap-start shrink-0 cursor-pointer
poster_card.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/20 to-transparent opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity duration-300

hero_banner.container: relative w-full min-h-[80vh] md:min-h-[85vh] flex flex-col justify-end
hero_banner.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0A0A0C] via-[#0A0A0C]/80 to-transparent z-10
hero_banner.vignette: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0A0A0C] via-transparent to-transparent z-10

buttons.primary: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#FF2A54] text-white px-8 py-3.5 font-bold tracking-wide transition-all hover:bg-[#FF4D71] hover:scale-105 active:scale-95 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,42,84,0.3)]
buttons.secondary_glass: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white backdrop-blur-md px-8 py-3.5 font-bold tracking-wide transition-all hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/10
buttons.icon_circle: flex items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10 p-3 hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors backdrop-blur-md

badges.streaming: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider
badges.status: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-1 rounded border border-white/10 bg-white/5 text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.1em]

tabs.container: flex space-x-1 p-1 bg-white/5 rounded-xl border border-white/5 backdrop-blur-sm
tabs.trigger: px-6 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-bold transition-all data-[state=active]:bg-white data-[state=active]:text-black text-white/60 hover:text-white

hero_backgrounds.description: Aerial view of dark skyscrapers at night, used for landing page hero background with vignette overlay.
Foggy night with glowing streetlights and distant moon, used for login/register page background.

media.notes_for_main_agent: Use TMDB API for actual series backdrops and posters. The images above are purely for the marketing splash and auth screens. CRITICAL: Use pure HTML+Tailwind for horizontal rails (do not force Shadcn carousel if it breaks standard snap scrolling). All posters MUST use aspect-[2/3] and backdrops aspect-video.
